comingLast.roast: the blue balls have been through worse hands - not many though
Gornall keeps refreshing the scores like it is the stock market
current run rate 1.4 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
needs 5 points from his last 3 to hand the blue balls to Gornall
on 23, needs 3 - somebody radio ahead to the bar
needs 7 in 5 - the kind of chase the bar was built for
at 1.5 a hole the blue balls fit like they were measured for him
in the clubhouse 1 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
done, 1 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
